title: Into the Shadow
overview: Desir and the others counterattack Esteban in the Shadow World's Evernatten to correct mistakes in history.

title: Judgment
overview: Having solved the conflict with Esteban, Desir and the others now must solve the refugee crisis.

title: Yellow Ocean
overview: Desir and his party visit Prillecha Kingdom to do special training for the Yellow Ocean Championship.

title: Beginning
overview: While Romantica, Pram, and Azest advance in the championship, a man in a crow mask attacks the castle.

title: Error
overview: Desir and his team confront Batour, Talka, and Sharina, who seem to work under the Crow Mask.

title: Arch Wizard
overview: Dadeinuf appears out of nowhere, and the Crow Mask attacks Desir and the others.

title: Awakening
overview: Desir faces the Crow Mask, and Zod clashes against Dadeinuf. Then, a bigger threat appears in front of Desir.
